title: 第十七章 咱爹是故意的还是不小心的第十八章 上清一脉的都这么勇的吗
content_zh:
“夜深了，三弟还不回去休息吗？”
看着白宣没有离开的意图，许玉华好奇问道。
“不了，此地距离武威虽不近，但对九境武者来说，并不遥远，一日一夜的时间，足够往返了，如果没有差错的话，他们今夜应该能把史夜行带回来。”白宣道。
武道九境，六品如喽啰，七品入道，方知天地玄妙，锤炼精神，知“炁”之玄妙，八品洞玄，洞察天地之玄妙，冥冥之中自生感应，祸福有兆，而九境通天，奇经八脉全通，五脏六腑内成天地，与天地相融，通天彻地，举手投足间便能牵引方圆百丈的天地元气。
秋临渊和李道衍都是九品通天境的。
虽不能像白宣这样乘风破浪，踏云而行，但也可御器凌空，算算时间，快回来了。
“既然这样，我也一并在这儿等着吧。”许玉华道。
“前夜，大姐你彻夜未眠，昨夜又经刺杀，也没睡好，再加上奔波三日，大姐你好好睡吧。”白宣劝道。
这几日，就没有一天好过。
他倒是没什么，铜皮铁骨，莫说三日不睡，便是三年也无妨，但许玉华自幼娇生惯养，又是女子，需要休息。
“无妨，横竖都已经三日了，也不在乎这一日。等候李先生他们回来，也需要时间，不如再教你些阵法知识，昨日的鸿运阵，你掌握多少了？”许玉华则拒绝了白宣的好意，好奇的看向白宣道。
白宣闻言，面色一滞。
鸿运阵？
差点忘了，还有这阵法。
他昨天得到诛仙阵图之后，就一门心思地钻进诛仙阵图里面去了，哪里还在意那不值一提的鸿运阵？
看都没看。
如今再问，就尴尬了。
想到这儿，白宣露出一个不好意思的表情，道：“阵法玄妙，我一时窥探不透。”
“初学者，大抵如此，不必自卑，我来教你。”许玉华看出白宣窘迫，只道白宣初学难以学会，温柔一笑，温婉优雅之态尽显。
白宣尴尬地笑着，听许玉华给他讲解阵纹布置。

许玉华不愧是钦天书院出身，在阵法认知上极有造诣，由浅入深，鞭辟入里。
白宣也从初时的尴尬转为认真听讲，听着许玉华的讲解，对阵的理解不断加深，外加这鸿运阵本身也不算难，白宣不多时便掌握大半，将七枚铜钱按照特定的形状摆放，然后将精神贯穿在符纸上，凝聚阵纹，启动阵法。
刹那间，七枚铜钱绽放出微弱光芒，彼此连通，形成一个虚幻的模样，阵阵微风吹过，白宣立时感觉，神清气爽。
“这是成了？”白宣看向许玉华道。
这么一看，我在阵道上，天赋好像也还行啊。
“成了，接下来一段时间，三弟你的运气会比平时更好一些。”许玉华有些惊讶地看着白宣，白宣的阵法天赋比她预想的要高些。
虽然这阵法简单，而且白宣是借助媒介，这些铜钱都是高人开过光的，但白宣短短一天就布置出来，天赋不可谓不高。
“但我也没什么感觉啊。”白宣道。
“运气的加持，不像别的阵法，表现大多不明显，很多时候帮你抵挡了灾劫，你也不知道，而且三弟你运气可能本身就很好，所以体现不出来。”许玉华解释道。
“原来如此。”白宣点头，照这么说来，没反应就正常了。
毕竟他最近的运气其实很不错。
虽然损失了亲爱的弟弟，但他终于找到了他恩人的转世。
在成仙之路上，迈出了大大的一步。
而且许世安也并非魂飞魄散，未来依旧有希望复活。
接下来，冒充许世安，入主镇北王府，更是可以享尽荣华富贵。
至于其中危险，除了大周、北荒、妖国三大皇城之外，几乎天下所有的地方，白宣都能来去自如。
“接下来，你便是熟悉这鸿运阵，反复练习，等了然于心之后，再学灾厄阵。”许玉华道。
content_en:
"It's late at night, why don't you, third brother, go back and rest?"
Seeing that Bai Xuan had no intention of leaving, Xu Yuhua asked curiously.
"No, although this place is not close to Wuwei, it is not far away for Nine Realm warriors. One day and one night is enough time for a round trip. If there are no mistakes, they should be able to bring Shi Yexing back tonight." Bai Xuandao.
The ninth level of martial arts, the sixth level is like a minions, the seventh level enters the Tao, you can know the mysteries of heaven and earth, temper your spirit, and know the mystery of "Qi". The eighth level Dongxuan can understand the mysteries of heaven and earth, and generate spontaneous induction in the dark. , there are omens of misfortune and good fortune, and the nine realms are connected to the sky, the eight meridians and eight meridians are all connected, the five internal organs become the heaven and the earth, blend with the heaven and the earth, connect the sky and the earth, and can draw the vitality of the heaven and the earth within a hundred feet with a single move.
Qiu Linyuan and Li Daoyan were both in the ninth-level Tongtian realm.
Although he can't ride the wind and waves or walk on the clouds like Bai Xuan, he can still fly with his weapon in the sky. Count the time and he will be back soon.
"In this case, I'll wait here too." Xu Yuhua said.
"The night before last, eldest sister, you stayed up all night. After being assassinated last night, you didn't sleep well. Plus, you have been traveling for three days. Sister, you should have a good sleep." Bai Xuan advised.
There has never been a good day these past few days.
He is nothing, he has a skin of bronze and iron bones, not to mention not sleeping for three days, even three years is not a problem, but Xu Yuhua has been pampered since childhood, and she is a woman, so she needs rest.
"It doesn't matter, it's been three days anyway, and I don't care about this day. It will take time to wait for Mr. Li and the others to come back. Why don't I teach you some formation knowledge. How much did you master yesterday's fortune formation?" Xu Yuhua rejected Bai Xuan's kindness and looked at Bai Xuande curiously.
When Bai Xuan heard this, his expression froze.
Lucky array?
I almost forgot, there is this formation.
After he got the Zhuxian Formation yesterday, he concentrated on getting into the Zhuxian Formation. Why did he care about the insignificant Fortune Formation?
Didn't even look at it.
It would be embarrassing to ask again now.
Thinking of this, Bai Xuan showed an embarrassed expression and said: "The formation is so mysterious that I can't see through it for the moment."
"Beginners, that's probably the case. Don't feel inferior. I'll teach you." Xu Yuhua saw Bai Xuan's embarrassment and said that it was difficult for Bai Xuan to learn as a beginner. He smiled gently, showing his gentleness and elegance.
Bai Xuan smiled awkwardly and listened to Xu Yuhua explain the formation layout to him.
Xu Yuhua deserves to be from Qintian Academy. He is extremely accomplished in the knowledge of formations, from simple to deep, and from the beginning to the inside.
Bai Xuan also changed from the initial embarrassment to listening carefully. Listening to Xu Yuhua's explanation, his understanding of the battle continued to deepen. In addition, the good luck formation itself was not difficult. Bai Xuan mastered most of it in a short time. He placed the seven copper coins in a specific shape, then penetrated his spirit on the talisman paper, condensed the formation patterns, and activated the formation.
In an instant, the seven copper coins bloomed with faint light and connected with each other, forming an illusory appearance. The breeze blew by, and Bai Xuan immediately felt refreshed.
"Is this done?" Bai Xuan looked at Xu Yuhua and asked.
Looking at it this way, my talent seems to be pretty good in terms of formation.
"It's done. In the next period of time, third brother, your luck will be better than usual." Xu Yuhua looked at Bai Xuan in surprise. Bai Xuan's talent for formations was higher than she expected.
Although this formation is simple, and Bai Xuan used a medium, and these copper coins were consecrated by experts, Bai Xuan arranged it in just one day, and his talent is not bad.
"But I don't feel anything." Bai Xuan said.
"Unlike other formations, the blessing of luck is mostly not obvious. Many times it helps you withstand disasters, but you don't even know it. And third brother, you may have good luck, so it doesn't show up." Xu Yuhua explained.
"That's it." Bai Xuan nodded. According to this, it was normal for him to have no reaction.
After all, his luck has been pretty good recently.
Although he lost his dear brother, he finally found the reincarnation of his benefactor.
On the road to immortality, a big step has been taken.
Moreover, Xu Shian is not completely lost, and there is still hope for resurrection in the future.
Next, if you pretend to be Xu Shian and enter the Zhenbei Palace, you will be able to enjoy all the glory and wealth.
As for the dangers, except for the three imperial cities of Dazhou, Beihuang and Demon Kingdom, Bai Xuan can come and go from almost all places in the world with ease.
"Next, you should become familiar with this good luck formation, practice it repeatedly, and then learn the disaster formation after you understand it by heart." Xu Yuhua said.
